target.title: feat(diffs): changed-files summary nav for multi-file patch diffs
target.body:
Closes #100673

## What Problem This Solves

Multi-file patch diffs in the `diffs` plugin viewer render as an undifferentiated stack of file cards: no overview of which files changed, no total change size, and no way to jump to a specific file. Rendered PNG/PDF exports also capture the interactive layout/wrap/background/theme toggle buttons, which are dead controls in a static file.

## Why This Change Was Made

Multi-file patches now get an SSR-rendered changed-files summary card — totals, per-file `+N`/`-N` counts, added/deleted/renamed badges, and anchor links to each file card — so navigation works in the hosted viewer and in file exports without extra JS. Per-file counts are computed from the hunk metadata `@pierre/diffs` already provides and match the library's built-in per-file header counts (which is why no per-file header chip was added — the header already shows counts). In image render mode the client now returns no header metadata, dropping the interactive toolbar from captures while keeping the built-in counts. Single-file diffs intentionally get no summary card.

## User Impact

Agents and users reviewing multi-file `diffs` tool output in canvas start with a clickable changed-files summary showing change size at a glance. PNG/PDF outputs no longer show inert toggle buttons.

## Evidence

- Dependency contract verified live against `@pierre/diffs@1.2.12`: `FileDiffMetadata.hunks[].additionLines/deletionLines`, `type` (`new`/`deleted`/`rename-*`), `prevName`, and the built-in header count rendering in `createFileHeaderElement.js`/`createMetadataElement`.
- New tests: summary nav content/anchors/totals, change-type badges, HTML escaping of file names, single-file suppression (`render.test.ts`); viewer-vs-image toolbar behavior and nav-card hydration skip (`viewer-client.test.ts`).
- Codex autoreview (gpt-5.5) on the change bundle: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Focused `extensions/diffs` suite run via the documented local fallback (`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/diffs`) because Blacksmith Testbox repeatedly shut down fresh leases during this session; hosted CI on this PR provides the delegated proof.
